commands.label: package-metadata
argv:
import sys,sysconfig,json,platform
from importlib import metadata
from pathlib import Path
purelib=sysconfig.get_path("purelib")
packages=[{"name":d.metadata["Name"],"version":d.version,"requires_dist":d.requires or [],"metadata_path":str(d._path),"installer":d.read_text("INSTALLER"),"wheel":d.read_text("WHEEL"),"direct_url":d.read_text("direct_url.json")} for d in metadata.distributions(path=[purelib])]
print(json.dumps({"version":sys.version,"prefix":sys.prefix,"base_prefix":sys.base_prefix,"executable":sys.executable,"real_executable":str(Path(sys.executable).resolve()),"purelib":purelib,"sys_path":sys.path,"machine":platform.machine(),"packages":sorted(packages,key=lambda d:d["name"].lower())},indent=2))
